Today's biggest story in India is Cyclone Arnab. At 11:30 AM on Tue 27 Oct, the very severe storm was about 170 km from Visakhapatnam. It is expected to hit land near Yanam by Wed 28 Oct, forenoon, with winds of 125-135 kmph gusting to 150 kmph. Odisha is moving 48,000 people out of eight districts, and Nepal is on high alert.

Other big stories today:

BRICS Parliamentary Forum adopted a joint declaration condemning the Pahalgam attack
Supreme Court asked the government to respond to pleas against the six-stanza Vande Mataram orders
PM Modi held talks with Liechtenstein's Prince Alois

This is my pick from The Hindu's national news page, so other papers may lead with something else.
